name: Dhroov Kanwar
quote: One of the Best Bakery in Zirakpur. Their Cheese Cakes are Very Delicious and they Make Amazing Cakes and Their Belgian Chocolate Pastry is must try.

name: Vaishali Singh
quote: One of the best bakery in tricity for all your celebrations. We have been ordering Gharelu for all our celebrations due to their quality. The cake is freshly baked, with top quality cream and authentic ingredients.

name: Manisha Chauhan
quote: Our first experience at Gharelu Bake was worth the hype. Amazing staff, super amazing food and the most delectable cakes. Top it all is the warm and welcoming owners and the gentle staff.

name: Kashish Sundwal
quote: The Tiramisu and Oreo Cheesecake were absolutely amazing! Both desserts literally melted in my mouth. The flavors were rich and perfectly balanced, and the sweetness was just right.

name: Kanika Madan
quote: I wanted to visit and try this place for so long! I've seen it grow from a home setup to a beautifully designed store — every corner has its own charm. The taste was superb.

name: Ujjwal Dilaik
quote: Had an amazing experience at Gharelu bakery as the owner was greeting and taking care of the customers. Ambience is really nice and food is amazing. My personal favourite is the Belgian chocolate pastry and the custard.

name: Anshul Kapil
quote: Ordered a special rainbow themed birthday cake for my son. It was a very beautiful rainbow cake. It looked exactly how we wanted it, also truly delicious and added a special touch to the celebration!

name: Lovepreet Kaur
quote: I ordered a cake from Canada for my friend, and Gharelu Cake Bakery made the whole process so smooth and stress-free! The team was very responsive and helpful with customization and delivery details. The cake was delivered on time.

name: Divyam Dilaik
quote: If you're hunting for the best bakery in the Zirakpur-Chandigarh area, look no further. The owners go out of their way to make you feel at home and offer great recommendations on what to order. Don't miss this place! 11/10 rating.
